title: Yara and the Ledger
author: O. M. Villalobos
blurb: Casper Dunmore, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
